content.title: About
content.content: The vegetarian hot dog is a plant‑based alternative to the classic hot dog, made from soy protein, wheat gluten and a blend of spices. It delivers the smoky, savory flavor of a traditional sausage without any meat, making it suitable for vegetarians and those reducing meat consumption.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Vegetarian hot dogs often use textured vegetable protein (TVP) derived from soy to mimic the meat‑like texture.
They come in a variety of flavors: classic smoked, spicy chili, barbecue, and even cheese‑infused.
Many brands fortify the product with B‑vitamins and iron to replace nutrients typically obtained from meat.
Vegetarian hot dogs are packaged in the same way as conventional ones, allowing an easy swap in recipes.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with meat counterparts, vegetarian hot dogs contain less saturated fat, which can support heart health.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Soy protein provides all essential amino acids, helping maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Rich in fiber when served with whole‑grain bun and veggies
items.content: Adding a whole‑grain bun and fresh toppings boosts dietary fiber for better digestion.

items.title: Cholesterol‑free
items.content: Absence of animal ingredients makes it virtually cholesterol‑free.

items.title: Contains iron and fortified B12
items.content: Some brands add iron and vitamin B12, nutrients important for vegetarians.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: People allergic to soy should avoid this product.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Certain varieties are high in salt; check the label if you watch sodium intake.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: If wheat gluten is used, the product is not suitable for those with celiac disease.

items.title: Processed ingredients
items.content: Like many convenience foods, it may contain preservatives and flavor enhancers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the hot dog in a pan, microwave, or on a grill, place it in a bun and add your favorite toppings: mustard, ketchup, pickles, sauerkraut, or avocado.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0 °C–4 °C in the original packaging for up to 5 days after opening. Freeze in an airtight bag for up to 3 months. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or strange appearance.
